data.sessions: every session (train and eval) of each mouse; refits on train sessions

labellings.global: Viterbi and smoothed posteriors under each run's global fit
labellings.refit: the same under each mouse's round-2 refit (r2's pick at that K)

cuts.rule: a trial counts for its Viterbi state if that state's smoothed posterior >= posterior_min and its same-state Viterbi run within the session is >= run_min trials long

data.coords: PC1-3 of the anchor's training cells (>= 200 trials), then the six named weights of r3_scores.named_features
